vnum0.name: Coruscant Galactic Academy - Grand Atrium
vnum0.desc:
Sunlight pours through towering transparisteel windows into the Grand Atrium of
the Coruscant Galactic Academy. Students and instructors from across the galaxy
move between halls leading to classrooms, simulators, and training facilities.
Holographic directories hover above the polished floor, guiding newcomers to
their destinations. The air hums with anticipation as every journey begins
within these walls.

f00a3557-cb49-4b9e-a9cc-5a35d7fb5fe0.name: Coruscant Galactic Academy - Cafeteria
f00a3557-cb49-4b9e-a9cc-5a35d7fb5fe0.desc:
Long rows of tables fill the Academy Cafeteria as students and instructors pause
between lessons to share meals and conversation. The aroma of freshly prepared
food drifts from serving stations where droids work tirelessly to keep hungry
recruits fed. Laughter, friendly debate, and the occasional boast about
simulator scores create a welcome contrast to the disciplined atmosphere found
elsewhere in the Academy.

bb988e81-b58c-409c-a35e-787b73017a2f.name: Coruscant Galactic Academy - Entrance Plaza
bb988e81-b58c-409c-a35e-787b73017a2f.desc:
A broad plaza stretches before the Academy, its polished stone alive with the
footsteps of students, travelers, and instructors. Speeders weave through the
traffic lanes high overhead while distant city sounds echo between towering
skyscrapers. The Academy's towering entrance stands to the north, welcoming
those eager to begin their journey, while the streets of Coruscant continue
south into the heart of the endless city.

537e52ef-4cbd-44ff-ad32-fdc2429183c8.name: Coruscant Galactic Academy - Flight Simulator
537e52ef-4cbd-44ff-ad32-fdc2429183c8.desc:
Rows of advanced flight simulators line the expansive training hall, each
projecting holographic starfields and distant worlds. Cadets practice takeoffs,
docking maneuvers, and hyperspace navigation under the watchful eyes of
experienced instructors. The steady hum of engines and computer systems fills
the room, reminding every recruit that mastering a starship is the first step
toward exploring the galaxy.

ad3e950d-1cf5-4d92-ae4e-bd61e5713093.name: Coruscant Galactic Academy - Engineering Lab
ad3e950d-1cf5-4d92-ae4e-bd61e5713093.desc:
Workbenches filled with tools, circuit boards, and dismantled droids line the
walls of the Engineering Lab. Students carefully assemble components while
instructors demonstrate the principles of repair, fabrication, and maintenance.
The occasional burst of sparks and the whir of diagnostic equipment fill the
air, reminding every recruit that a skilled engineer can keep both machines and
starships running when it matters most.

12612dd2-13fc-40bb-a988-6ac9d50f6b93.name: Coruscant Galactic Academy - Combat Annex
12612dd2-13fc-40bb-a988-6ac9d50f6b93.desc:
Reinforced walls and padded training areas fill the Combat Annex, where recruits
hone their skills in controlled exercises. Practice remotes drift through the
room while training droids spar with cadets under the supervision of seasoned
instructors. The sharp crack of stun bolts and the clash of practice weapons
echo through the hall, reminding every student that discipline and preparation
are as valuable as strength in battle.
